EchoRight is an easy-to-use educational app intended for cardiologists, echocardiographers, and sonographers to help learn the echocardiographic signs of pulmonary hypertension (PH).​
•Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) is a condition that encompasses a group of severe clinical diseases, such as Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) and Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension (CTEPH).​
By evaluating a brief case description, with EchoRight app you will learn:​
•The importance and relevance of a systematic examination of the right heart during echocardiography, the most important non invasive screening tool for PH​
•The key parameters for detecting PH​

PHYSIOMED Smart Assistant is a QR code based service for generating treatment reports from PHYSIOMED therapy systems.

For this purpose, the PHYSIOMED therapy system generates a QR code, which is decoded by the PHYSIOMED Smart Assistant and made available via a database.
Reports can be created, printed or sent in PDF format.
For a synchronization a login and internet connection is necessary.

Features:
- Creation of treatment reports from PHYSIOMED therapy systems
- Summary of treatments for a treatment report (patient or period)
- Treatment parameters can be selected for the treatment report
- Help with service messages
